title: Refresh time-sensitive wave-1 figures after the Q3 2026 reporting season: Micron FQ4 2026 actuals vs guidance, TSMC 2026 capex, and other claims marked outdated
why_it_matters: Several W1 figures are guidance, forecasts or dated snapshots that are now superseded or about to be: Micron guided FQ4 2026 revenue of US$50.0bn +/- 1.0bn at ~86% gross margin (CLM-1145) and reports on 30 Sep 2026; fact-checkers marked 12 claims outdated. The atlas must show actuals, not stale guidance, and the memory-cycle narrative depends on whether the guided peak was met.
questions: What revenue and gross margin did Micron actually report for fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ending about end-August 2026), how did they compare with the guidance in CLM-1145, and what did it guide for fiscal Q1 2027?
What does Micron's fiscal 2026 10-K say about DRAM and NAND ASP and bit-shipment changes (unknown CLM-1215)?
What is TSMC's latest 2026 capital budget and advanced-packaging share (superseding CLM-0770)?

What are the current IEA data-centre electricity estimates (superseding CLM-0815), the current WSTS member count (CLM-0737), the latest Yole advanced-packaging market figures (CLM-1035) and the latest SEMI/TechSearch assembly-and-test facility count (CLM-1051)?
What is the current text and licence policy of 15 CFR 744.6(c)(2) (US-persons restriction), which fact-checkers marked outdated (CLM-0868, CLM-0869)?
subquestions: Record every refreshed figure as a new claim with its own period; do not edit the old claims (they stay as history).
primary_sources: Micron fiscal Q4 2026 earnings release (8-K exhibit 99.1, SEC EDGAR) and fiscal 2026 Form 10-K
TSMC quarterly management report and earnings call (3Q26, mid-October 2026)
origin_ref: gap-W1-8c3f (fact-check follow-up on CLM-1145 and 12 outdated W1 claims)
open_questions: Do not start before 1 Oct 2026 (Micron reports after market close on 30 Sep 2026). CHIPS award/disbursement refresh (CLM-0908/0912/0981/0982/0987) is in RU-0256, not here.
